target.title: policy: repair denied gateway http endpoints
target.body:
## Summary

- Restack on current `main` after #99720 merged.
- Classify `policy/gateway-http-endpoint-enabled` as an automatic narrowing repair.
- Wire `doctor --fix` to set the exact reported denied Gateway HTTP endpoint `enabled` paths to `false`.
- Document that denied Gateway HTTP endpoints can be auto-disabled when `workspaceRepairs=true`.
- Leave URL-fetch allowlist findings manual; this PR only disables denied endpoints and preserves nested endpoint config.

## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
`doctor --fix` can now repair denied Gateway HTTP endpoint findings by disabling the reported endpoint paths while preserving nested endpoint options such as URL-fetch settings.

Real environment tested:
WSL Ubuntu source checkout at PR head `5b0a96c416da51a739c8091090bb538cb6b4153e`, rebased on current `main`. The proof used the real Policy doctor registration plus `runDoctorHealthRepairs` against an isolated temp workspace with `plugins.entries.policy.config.workspaceRepairs=true`; no live Gateway server, provider, or network call was started.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. Seed isolated `openclaw.jsonc` with `gateway.http.endpoints.chatCompletions.enabled=true`, `gateway.http.endpoints.responses.enabled=true`, nested URL-fetch options, and `workspaceRepairs=true`.
2. Seed isolated `policy.jsonc` with `gateway.http.denyEndpoints=["chatCompletions","responses"]` and `gateway.http.requireUrlAllowlists=true`.
3. Run source-entry repair proof: `node --import tsx .local/proof-99731.mts`, which calls `registerPolicyDoctorChecks` and `runDoctorHealthRepairs` for `policy/gateway-http-endpoint-enabled`.
4. Run focused validation: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts --reporter=dot`.
5. Run docs/format/diff validation: `pnpm docs:map:check`; `pnpm exec oxfmt --check` for touched docs/policy files; `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`; `git diff --check`.

Evidence after fix:
```text
HEAD=local
WORKSPACE=/tmp/policy-gateway-http-proof-NFt6xW
CHECKS_RUN=1
CHECKS_REPAIRED=1
CHECKS_VALIDATED=1
BEFORE_FINDINGS=[{"checkId":"policy/gateway-http-endpoint-enabled","ocPath":"oc://openclaw.config/gateway/http/endpoints/chatCompletions/enabled","requirement":"oc://policy.jsonc/gateway/http/denyEndpoints"},{"checkId":"policy/gateway-http-endpoint-enabled","ocPath":"oc://openclaw.config/gateway/http/endpoints/responses/enabled","requirement":"oc://policy.jsonc/gateway/http/denyEndpoints"}]
CHANGES=["Set gateway.http.endpoints.chatCompletions.enabled=false for policy conformance.","Set gateway.http.endpoints.responses.enabled=false for policy conformance."]
AFTER_ENDPOINTS={"chatCompletions":{"enabled":false,"images":{"allowUrl":true}},"responses":{"enabled":false,"files":{"allowUrl":true},"images":{"allowUrl":true,"urlAllowlist":["images.example.test"]}}}
REMAINING_FINDINGS=0
REMAINING=[]
```

Supporting validation:
```text
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 9.02s
Test Files: 2 passed
Tests: 299 passed

docs:map: docs/docs_map.md is up to date.
All matched files use the correct format.
git diff --check origin/main...HEAD passed.
git diff --check passed.
```

Observed result after fix:
The repair flow detected both denied Gateway HTTP endpoint findings, repaired both reported `enabled` leaves to `false`, validated with zero remaining endpoint findings, and preserved the nested URL-fetch options (`images.allowUrl`, `files.allowUrl`, and `images.urlAllowlist`) on the disabled endpoints.

What was not tested:
No live Gateway HTTP server, live provider, network URL-fetch call, or LLM call was run. URL-fetch allowlist findings intentionally remain manual and are not auto-repaired by this PR.

## Stack

- Directly stacked on current `main` after #99720 merged.
- Next downstream slice remains #99776 after this PR is ready.
